reasoning_steps: Satellite records maintained continuously since 1979 by agencies such as NASA and the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC) confirm that Arctic sea ice extent has declined significantly

claim_traces.claim_text: "mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA."
reasoning_steps: Extensive scientific consensus from major health organizations (including the CDC, WHO, and NIH) and molecular biology literature confirms that mRNA COVID-19 vaccines do not alter, integrate into, or permanently change human DNA
Messenger RNA delivers temporary instructions to the cellular cytoplasm to produce the spike protein, triggering an immune response
The mRNA never enters the cell nucleus where DNA resides, cannot be converted into DNA without reverse transcriptase enzymes, and naturally degrades quickly within the cell
Claims suggesting genomic alteration have been widely debunked.

claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short at around 5 feet 2 inches is a well-documented historical myth
Napoleon's height was recorded at his autopsy as roughly 5 feet 2 inches in pre-metric French units ("pieds" and "pouces")

Because a French inch (pouce) was approximately 2.71 centimeters compared to the English inch of 2.54 centimeters, his height in modern imperial measurements translates to roughly 5 feet 6 to 5 feet 7 inches (around 1.67 to 1.69 meters)
This made him average or even slightly above average height for a French man in the early 19th century
The misconception was further amplified by British wartime propaganda caricatures (such as those by James Gillray) and his nickname "le Petit Caporal."
